_readme: Settings of the historical CC200 pipeline that are VERIFIED from code or files. 'source' gives the file (and line) that proves each setting. Anything not provable is listed under 'not_recoverable' and was NOT guessed. Atlas: CC200 only.

run_identity.claim: fc_v2_results.csv row 'LogReg-L2 (baseline)', exp 2A, reported holdout accuracy 0.7412
run_identity.invocation_status: INFERRED, not recorded: one row, cv_auc_std = cv_acc_std = 0.0, elapsed 0.44 min, file written 45 s after the script was saved; no log of the run exists

time_series_file.format: numpy object array, one (timepoints x 200) array per subject, order of d.rois_cc200
time_series_file.sha256_check: matches the value recorded in splits/phase2_split_metadata.json (2026-09-09)

covariance.preprocessing: per subject: z-score each ROI over time (x - mean) / (std + 1e-8)

connectivity.note: a Ledoit-Wolf shrunk correlation, NOT the plain sample Pearson correlation

vectorization.triangle: upper triangle, diagonal excluded, np.triu_indices(200, k=1), row-major (i < j)
vectorization.note: equivalent set of 19,900 unordered ROI pairs to a lower-triangle extraction; only the column order would differ

demographics.sex: SEX numeric as in the phenotype file (1/2), 1 column
demographics.scaling: separate StandardScaler fitted on training rows
demographics.position: appended after the 19,900 connectivity columns (last two columns)

model.scaler: StandardScaler fitted on the training portion (applied to all 19,902 columns)
model.classifier: sklearn LogisticRegression(penalty L2, solver lbfgs, max_iter 5000, class_weight 'balanced')
model.C_selection: GridSearchCV, scoring roc_auc, refit=True, inner StratifiedKFold(5, shuffle=True, random_state=<outer seed>)

split.holdout_status: reused across scripts; superseded by the phase-2 split (see audit_report.md)

evaluation.threshold: Youden's J on the pooled out-of-fold scores of the 676 train/val subjects (the same scores later summarized as CV accuracy)
evaluation.holdout_step: refit on all 676 (inner StratifiedKFold(5, random_state=42)), score the 170 once with the recorded threshold

recorded_results.status: recorded and internally consistent; NOT independently verified or validated (holdout reused)

not_recoverable: the fitted estimator, scaler and threshold (nothing is serialized by train_fc*.py)
per-subject CV or holdout predictions and scores
the log of the run that wrote fc_v2_results.csv, hence the exact invocation (inferred only)
the C value selected for the final fit
software versions (python, numpy, scikit-learn) used at the time
the script that first created covs_cc200.npy (file dated 2026-08-19 16:26; the current train_fc.py reuses it when its row count equals the filtered subject count); no hash of it was recorded
